feeds.title: Sports Feel Good Stories
feeds.description: Sports Feel Good Stories showcases inspiring tales of good deeds, resilience, and sportsmanship. Through uplifting narratives and motivational quotes, it celebrates individuals overcoming obstacles and embodying the spirit of sportsmanship, igniting motivation in readers.

feeds.title: Every Kid Sports Blog
feeds.description: At Every Kid Sports, the mission revolves around granting every child an opportunity to engage in sports through the Every Kid Sports Pass. They passionately believe in levelling the playing field, ensuring every child, irrespective of their financial situation, can access the transformative power of sports. Their unwavering dedication dismantles financial barriers, opening doors for all children to thrive in sports.

feeds.title: Trusted Coaches
feeds.description: Trusted Coaches, a nonprofit formed by @myasminnesota and @badgerlandwss, focuses on coaching education and youth athlete safety. Their risk management platform provides online training, ensuring coaches are equipped to create safe environments for young athletes. Through education, they empower organizations to prioritize child safety in youth sports, fostering a culture of trust and protection.

feeds.title: Way of Champions Podcast
feeds.description: The Way of Champions Podcast is hosted by Dr. Jerry Lynch and John O'Sullivan, team culture and performance specialists. Each week we connect you with the top minds in sports, coaching, leadership, and building championship programs so you can take your athletes and teams to the next level.

feeds.title: SoCal Youth Sports Blog
feeds.description: SoCal Youth Sports, a youth sports organization, provides soccer classes, camps, and clinics fostering skill development and life lessons. Prioritizing creativity, curiosity, and courage, they cultivate a secure and encouraging environment where children flourish both athletically and personally.

feeds.title: Youth Challenge Sports Blog
feeds.description: Youth Challenge Sports unites young individuals with physical disabilities and teen volunteers, fostering inspiration through adapted sports and recreational activities. Their blog highlights insightful stories about programs, events, participants, and volunteers, offering enriching reading experiences for all.

feeds.title: Working with Parents in Sport Blog
feeds.description: 'Working with Parents in Sport' collaborates with organizations, coaches, parents, and children globally to optimize youth development in and out of sports. Based in the UK, they offer impartial guidance, acknowledging contemporary challenges. Partnering with renowned entities like the Youth Sport Trust and Spond, they support various sporting organizations including England Rugby, British Gymnastics, and more, fostering effective collaboration among stakeholders.

feeds.title: ACES Nation Blog
feeds.description: ACES Nation offers comprehensive coaching and club management solutions, aiming to simplify processes and enhance community impact through sports. Their transformative vision strives to enrich lives and empower individuals. The News for the Nation Blog, authored by former college athletes and coaches, serves as a valuable resource for athletes and coaches worldwide, sharing insights and expertise to foster development and success.

feeds.title: Better Coaching Blog
feeds.description: At Better Coaching blog, readers explore Coach Sullivan's insights and experiences, aimed at enhancing youth sports. Delving into diverse topics, the blog serves as a resource for coaches, parents, and athletes, fostering improvement and growth within the sports community, one individual at a time.

feeds.title: Whole Child Sports Blog
feeds.description: Whole Child Sports prioritizes holistic, safe, and age-appropriate athletic journeys for children, countering the prevailing toxic and hyper-competitive youth sports culture in the United States. Their approach fosters wholesome development, ensuring kids thrive in a supportive environment.

feeds.title: Youth Sports Club Management Blog
feeds.description: TeamGenius, founded by former youth athletes, champions the transformative potential of youth sports in fostering resilient individuals and communities. Their software streamlines team formation boosts operational efficiency, and promotes positive player development, coaches, and referees. Based in Minnesota, Todd Larson and Chris Knutson lead the charge towards inclusive and impactful youth sports participation. The TeamGenius blog is the best place to find youth sports club management tips, coaching best practices, drills, and more.

feeds.title: CoachUp Nation
feeds.description: Founded by Jordan Lancaster Fliegel in 2011, CoachUp democratizes private coaching for youth worldwide. Fliegel's journey from average high school player to collegiate and professional athlete inspired the platform. CoachUp connects athletes with coaches across 32 sports, offering personalized lessons to enhance individual performance and skills.

feeds.title: KidsUnited Blog
feeds.description: KidsUnited, a youth soccer development centre, nurtures children aged 1.5 10, fostering individual growth at their own pace. With a focus on health and confidence, KidsUnited tackles the challenges kids face today, guiding them to success while having fun. Parents seek solutions for their children's growth, confidence, and success, finding a welcoming environment at KidsUnited.

feeds.title: Maui Youth Sports Blog
feeds.description: Maui Youth Sports serves as a comprehensive resource hub for children's sports, consolidating information on soccer, football, basketball, and track and field. Offering news archives and scholarship details, it centralizes essential information, simplifying access to sports opportunities for Maui's youth.

feeds.title: Legacy Sports Camp Blog
feeds.description: Established in 2008 by Oak Park natives Dan Kane and Caleb Fields, Legacy Sports Camp offers a spectrum of programs from after-school to summer camps. Emphasizing proper technique and character development, they infuse positive traits into young athletes. Their vibrant, safe, and challenging atmosphere ensures a fulfilling experience for participants.

feeds.title: T.I.M.E Youth Sports Blog
feeds.description: T.I.M.E Youth Sports, a nonprofit, collaborates with Southern Indiana communities, advocating youth athletics with a focus on Training, Integrity, Motivation, and Encouragement. They extend support to families and communities facing resource constraints, fostering inclusivity and growth in youth sports endeavours.

feeds.title: National Council of Youth Sports
feeds.description: The National Council of Youth Sports (NCYS) has trained coaches, educators, and families to ensure safe participation in youth sports since 1978. As a charitable organization, NCYS connects a vast network of stakeholders, serving 60M youth in sports programs. With a comprehensive approach, NCYS spearheads transformative efforts, creating a positive impact on individuals and organizations nationwide.

feeds.title: Beyond the Bench
feeds.description: The National Sports Center's Beyond the Bench blog offers insights and updates from the world's largest amateur sports facility. Covering diverse topics, it provides valuable perspectives beyond the games, catering to athletes, coaches, and sports enthusiasts alike.

feeds.title: Travis Daugherty Blog
feeds.description: Travis Daugherty, as Husband, Father, Coach, and Founder/Director of @Champions_101, is dedicated to cultivating worthy winners in athletes, coaches, and parents. With 20 years in education, his mission centres on teaching and empowering individuals to excel in life's vital aspects. Passionate about growth and improvement, Daugherty's commitment resonates in his lifelong endeavour to uplift others.

feeds.title: Greater Youth Sports Association
feeds.description: Greater Youth Sports Association (GYSA), a nonprofit, offers Sports and Educational opportunities for at-risk youth, cultivating an environment conducive to growth and success. Through their programs, GYSA fosters holistic development, empowering youth with essential skills and support for a brighter future.

feeds.title: SportsPlus Blog
feeds.description: The Sports Management Software Platform revolutionizes club and league management, offering comprehensive solutions for websites, registrations, payments, scheduling, and more. Empowering youth sports, it simplifies operations like registrations, scheduling, fundraising, and communication, consolidating all aspects into a single, user-friendly platform.
